subsidy_scheme_guide.scheme_name: PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana
subsidy_scheme_guide.ministry: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy (MNRE)
subsidy_scheme_guide.objective: Free electricity up to 300 units/month via grid-connected rooftop solar
calculation_formula: For systems up to 2 kW: Central Financial Assistance = 60% of benchmark cost per kW
For the 3rd kW (2-3 kW): Central Financial Assistance = 40% of benchmark cost for that kW
Total maximum central subsidy = Rs. 78,000 (for 3 kW and above)
Systems above 3 kW: Subsidy capped at Rs. 78,000; owner pays the difference
eligibility: Must be an Indian citizen (individual or joint homeowner)
Must own a residential property with valid title/proof
Must have a valid electricity consumer connection from a DISCOM
Rooftop must have sufficient shadow-free area for panel installation
Household must not have previously availed any government solar subsidy
Both individual homes and group housing societies are eligible
No income ceiling — all income groups can apply
application_steps: Click on 'Apply for Rooftop Solar' on the homepage
Register using your Aadhaar-linked mobile number (OTP verification)
Enter your electricity consumer number from your latest bill
Fill in personal details: name, address, property documents, bank details
Select desired system capacity (1 kW, 2 kW, or 3 kW) — portal shows exact subsidy
Choose from MNRE-empanelled solar vendors listed for your area
Vendor conducts free site visit, verifies rooftop, gives final system design
DISCOM issues feasibility approval and sanctions net metering connection
Installation takes place (typically 2-3 days for residential systems)
DISCOM inspects installation and issues commissioning certificate
Upload bank account details + cancelled cheque on the portal
Subsidy credited directly to your bank account within 30 days of commissioning

key_benefits.details: Up to 300 units/month free for households generating from solar
Up to Rs. 78,000 (maximum) for 3 kW and above systems
Sell surplus electricity back to grid; earn credit on electricity bill
Banks like SBI offer solar loans at concessional rates
~4.5 tonnes CO2 avoided per 3 kW household per year
Typically 4-5 years after subsidy. System lasts 25+ years.
Average Rs. 4-6 lakh over 25 years for a 3 kW system

important_rules: Only ALMM-listed domestic panels qualify — non-listed panels disqualify the application
Subsidy valid only after DISCOM commissioning certificate is issued
Net metering mandatory — system must be grid-connected; off-grid systems do not qualify
Only one subsidy per household — prior government solar subsidies disqualify
System size cap — subsidy capped at 3 kW; larger systems allowed but subsidy doesn't increase
Bank account must match applicant name — joint accounts accepted if applicant is listed
